description: Collapse the CLI consumption layer's duplicated logic into single shared implementations: one command prelude (output-mode validation + project-reference resolution), one generic HTTP send path, one envelope parser; and remove the deprecated single-field `model` config fallback in ConfigService. No CLI output/exit-code behavior changes (legacy `model` fallback removal is the sole declared exception); no command-tree regrouping; no table-renderer changes.

tasks.title: Remove legacy single-field model config fallback from ConfigService
tasks.description: Delete the `model`-synthesis fallback in ConfigService.GetAgentConfigAsync so agent config originates solely from the `agent` object. Remove the `model` entry from the config schema (ConfigService.cs:27), drop the `ClearAsync("model")` retained only to avoid legacy shadowing inside SetAgentModelAsync (L214-215), and fix the XML docs on GetAgentConfigAsync (L116-118) and GetVariables (L182-183) that reference the fallback. Rework ConfigServiceSpecs.cs: remove the GetVariables_OnlyLegacyModelSet_SynthesizesAgentObject assertion and replace it with one asserting model-only yields no agent config (null bundle), and switch the GetAll_MasksSecrets secret-masking probe from the retired `model` key to an existing non-sensitive schema key (e.g. `logLevel`) so the round-trip probe still exercises masking without hitting the removed schema entry. SetAgentModelAsync continues to write model under the unified `agent` object and clears the `agent` key when emptied.
acceptanceCriteria: GetAgentConfigAsync returns null when config.jsonc defines only `model` and no `agent` object (spec scenario 'model-only config no longer synthesizes an agent configuration').
GetAgentConfigAsync still returns the `agent` object verbatim when one is configured; returns null when neither `agent` nor `model` is set.
GetVariables returns a VariableBundle with null Vars and null Stages when only `model` is set, i.e. no synthesized `agent` entry (spec scenario 'model-only config yields an empty bundle').
GetVariables with an `agent` object configured still nests it under `vars.agent` and does not leak a top-level `model` sibling.

The `model` key is gone from the config schema; SetAgentModelAsync no longer calls ClearAsync("model"), still writes model under `agent.model`, and still clears the `agent` key when the resulting agent object has no remaining keys.
GetAll_MasksSecrets verifies secret masking via a non-legacy probe key (e.g. `logLevel`); the behavior it asserts is unchanged.
`npm test` (server spec) is green; `npm run build` (Mohist.sln, TreatWarningsAsErrors) succeeds with zero warnings.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Infrastructure/Config/ConfigService.cs with the model fallback, schema entry, and ClearAsync("model") removed and docs fixed; updated ConfigServiceSpecs.cs; server specs green
tasks.notes: Design D4. Isolated to the server config layer; no API consumers (ConfigRoutes/OpencodeRoutes/AgentJobGrain) change because they all resolve through GetAgentConfigAsync/SetAgentModelAsync against the unified `agent` object. BREAKING only for configs that set a bare top-level `model` without an `agent` object — declared as the sole accepted exception. No migration shim required (project declares no version compatibility).

tasks.title: Consolidate envelope success/error/code extraction into one parser
tasks.description: Add a single private envelope extraction in MohistCliApi — e.g. ExtractEnvelope(JsonNode? node, HttpResponseMessage response) returning a record carrying HasBody/Success/Data/Error/Code where Success = node?["success"]?.GetValue<bool>() ?? response.IsSuccessStatusCode, plus a FailureExitCode(HttpResponseMessage) helper encoding the NotFound→4 / else→1 mapping. Rewrite the 6+ scattered extraction blocks (PrintResponseAsync, PrintRawResponseAsync, ReadPostResultAsync, ReadSuccessDataAsync, PrintProjectListAsync, PrintSystemInfoAsync, PrintRunnerShowAsync) to delegate to it, and convert the two external rewrites — MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs ReadDataOrPrintErrorAsync (~:860) and Otel.cs (~:181) — to delegate as well. Share only the field extraction; keep each call site's own print/throw strategy intact, and keep ReadSuccessDataAsync's ApiResponseException throw contract unchanged (its 7 callers depend on the catch). This is an internal private refactor with no call-site signature changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one implementation of the `node["success"]?.GetValue<bool>() ?? response.IsSuccessStatusCode` → error/code extraction remains in the CLI; no second copy survives in MohistCliApi or in Agent.cs/Otel.cs (spec requirement 'Single envelope parsing implementation').
A response body that parses to JSON but omits `success` is treated as successful iff the HTTP status indicates success (spec scenario 'Missing success field falls back to HTTP status').
The NotFound(404)→exit 4 vs generic-failure→exit 1 mapping is defined exactly once (FailureExitCode) and consumed by all failure paths.
ReadSuccessDataAsync still throws ApiResponseException for its 7 callers; only the field extraction is shared, not the throw/print decision.

PrintSystemInfoAsync keeps its command-level HttpRequestException→RenderSystemInfoDegradedAsync+exit 0 recovery in place (NOT folded into the generic server-unavailable handling), and Otel.cs's broader TaskCanceledException catch stays untouched.
`dotnet test packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests` passes; success/error/404/empty-body output and exit codes are unchanged (spec requirement 'Unchanged success, failure, and not-found behavior').
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliApi.cs with a single ExtractEnvelope/FailureExitCode and all duplicated extraction blocks removed; Agent.cs and Otel.cs delegating to it; CLI specs green
tasks.notes: Design D3. Share extraction only — deliberately do NOT merge PrintResponseAsync/PrintRawResponseAsync/ReadPostResultAsync into one parameterized reader (their success-path output shapes differ; merging would widen the regression surface). Lower-risk than D2 so it runs first; call sites are unchanged, so blast radius is contained inside MohistCliApi.

tasks.title: Consolidate the five verb HTTP methods into one generic send
tasks.description: Add a single private SendAsync(HttpMethod method, string path, object? body) in MohistCliApi that owns request construction (internalizing the PATCH HttpRequestMessage + JsonContent.Create path) and centralizes HttpRequestException → ServerUnavailableMessage + exit 1 handling. Reduce the five Print*Async (Get/Post/Put/Patch/Delete) and the five *WithOutputAsync variants to thin forwarders that delegate to SendAsync, preserving the public surface used by command call sites. Observable network-failure behavior strictly improves: previously-throwing bare PrintGetAsync/PostAsync/... now exit 1 with the server-unavailable message like the *WithOutputAsync/*Safe variants already did. Do not fold in PrintSystemInfoAsync's command-level degraded recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: All of GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE flow through one SendAsync request path; no per-verb duplicate of request construction or of the HttpRequestException → server-unavailable handling remains (spec scenario 'All verbs route through one request path').

A request that fails with HttpRequestException (server unreachable) writes the server-unavailable message to error output and returns exit 1 for every verb, including the bare PrintGetAsync/PostAsync/PutAsync/PatchAsync/DeleteAsync that previously threw (spec scenario 'Network failure prints the server-unavailable message').
If no existing CLI spec covers the bare-verb network-failure path, add a CLI spec asserting that an unreachable server yields stderr containing ServerUnavailableMessage and exit code 1.
Success/error/404/empty-body output and exit codes are identical to before for the previously-already-handled paths (spec requirement 'Unchanged success, failure, and not-found behavior').
The five *WithOutputAsync variants remain callable from command call sites unchanged (thin forwarders).
`dotnet test packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests` passes.
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliApi.cs with a single SendAsync and the ten verb methods reduced to thin forwarders; CLI specs green (plus any added network-failure spec)
tasks.notes: Design D2. The only intentional behavior change is 'crash → graceful exit 1' for bare verb methods on HttpRequestException — a strict improvement covered by spec. A request-factory Func<HttpClient,Task<HttpResponseMessage>> was rejected (method+body is sufficient for all five verbs). Sequenced after T-002 because both edit MohistCliApi.cs; T-002 is lower-risk (zero call-site change) and lands first.

tasks.title: Converge output-mode and project-reference preludes to one shared helper each
tasks.description: Add two shared instance methods on MohistCliApi — ResolveOutputMode(string? output) returning (string Mode, int Exit) by wrapping the existing static ValidateOutputMode, and ResolveProject(string? project, string? projectId) returning Task<(string ProjectId, int Exit)> by wrapping the existing ResolveProjectIdAsync, converting OutputModeResult.Invalid/null into the (value, exit-code) tuples. Delete the three duplicated definitions — IssueCommands.ValidateOutput (MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs:61), EpicCommands.ValidateOutput (Epic.cs:38), and IssueCommands.ResolveProjectId (Issue.cs:72) — and migrate every call site compiler-error-driven: 33 ValidateOutput(api,o) → api.ResolveOutputMode(o), 29 ResolveProjectId(api,…) → api.ResolveProject(…), 27 inline ValidateOutputMode+Invalid pattern matches (Agent ×8, ProjectWorkflow ×9, etc.) → api.ResolveOutputMode, and 9 inline ResolveProjectIdAsync+null checks → api.ResolveProject. Exit codes and mode/resolution semantics stay identical.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one shared output-mode prelude exists; no per-resource ValidateOutput(MohistCliApi,string?) definition survives in Issue/Epic/Agent/Workflow/Project/ProjectWorkflow/Label/System/Server/Repository/Opencode partials (spec scenario 'All command partials share one implementation').

Exactly one shared project-reference prelude exists; the per-resource ResolveProjectId(MohistCliApi,string?,string?) wrapper is gone and every former call site uses the shared helper (spec scenario 'All command partials share one resolution helper').
No inline MohistCliApi.ValidateOutputMode + OutputModeResult.Invalid pattern match and no inline ResolveProjectIdAsync + null check remain in the command partials.

Output-mode resolution is unchanged: unset/blank/json → json (exit 0), table → table (exit 0), other → '--output must be \'table\' or \'json\' (got \'<value>\')' to error output and exit 1 (spec scenarios).

Project resolution is unchanged: --project name resolves, --project-id takes precedence, conflicting --project/--project-id is rejected (exit 1), neither falls back to persisted active project (exit 0), and missing/unreadable active project yields the no-active-project message + exit 1 (spec scenarios).
`npm run build` (Mohist.sln, TreatWarningsAsErrors as lint) is green — the compiler-error-driven sweep leaves no stray ValidateOutput/inline references.
`dotnet test packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests` passes with no regression.
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliApi.cs with ResolveOutputMode + ResolveProject; the three duplicated prelude definitions deleted from MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs / .Epic.cs; all ~60 call sites migrated across the command partials; CLI specs green
tasks.notes: Design D1. Helpers land on the MohistCliApi instance (the `api` already threaded into every handler; the underlying ValidateOutputMode/ResolveProjectIdAsync already live there) — a shared static hub on MohistCliCommands (composition root) or a new CommandPrelude type was rejected. Largest sweep (~60 mechanical call-site edits); sequenced last and driven by compile errors so no straggler survives. Touches the same MohistCliApi.cs as T-002/T-003, hence runs after them.
